cohort: Three hundred singleton pregnancies with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) diagnosed between 24+0 and 33+6 weeks.
finding: Maternal delta neutrophil index (DNI) levels were significantly higher in the chorioamnionitis group and were identified as an independent predictor of clinical chorioamnionitis in PPROM, although its diagnostic performance for early detection of intrauterine infection is limited.
